messages:
Sam (People Ops): Thanks for the great questions in today's all-hands about hybrid expectations, travel, and offsite logistics  thread to capture answers and next steps.
Iris (Facilities): Q: Can we book half-day desks for focused mornings? A lot of folks asked.
Sam (People Ops): Yes  half-day morning/afternoon slots rolling out May 10. Facilities will post the updated booking UI.
Noel (Head of Eng): For teams that need more predictable overlap, can managers require one core day? How strict should teams be?
Sam (People Ops): Managers can set a required core day for their team after consulting team members. If a role has on-site-only duties, note it on the job posting. People Ops will publish a one-page guide for managers.
Priya (Sales): Offsite question: company covers travel+hotel for quarterly offsites, but what about partners who join day sessions?
Owen (Finance): Partners invited as guests are billed as client entertainment. Employees' travel/hotel covered by Redwood; partner expenses go through client-entertainment flow with receipts and attendee list.
hoteling-bot: Heads up: "business-travel" booking tag live next week. Book at /hoteling.
Priya (Sales): Coworking passes when in-city for customer meetings  reimbursable?
travel-bot: Coworking reimbursable up to $50/day with manager pre-approval. Upload receipt to Expensify and tag "coworking".
Noel (Head of Eng): Emergency on-call travel: can we book same-day?
Sam (People Ops): Emergency ops travel allowed; use the expedited travel form and notify your manager. Finance will prioritize reimbursement.
Iris (Facilities): Note on conference rooms: multi-day workshop requests should use the workshop form at least 10 business days out to avoid conflicts.
Owen (Finance): Action items recap: 1) Finance to add Expensify tags (team-offsite, client-entertainment, coworking) by May 1; 2) People Ops to publish manager guide + booking template by Apr 28; 3) Facilities to enable half-day slots and business-travel tag by May 10.
Sam (People Ops): If you have edge cases (visa costs, ADA needs, dependent-care), DM People Ops. I'll update this thread when items are live. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
